scope: Bounded real-data structural replay study; not a reproduction of adaptive LLM discovery or a production-fleet claim

data.attribution: Cortez, Cerdeira, Almeida, Matos and Reis (2009), Wine Quality, UCI, doi:10.24432/C56S3T, CC BY 4.0
data.split: Deduplicate complete numeric rows before seeded shuffle (140); first 50% discovery, next 25% calibration, remainder validation
data.normalisation: Column mean and population standard deviation fitted to discovery only, including target; store little-endian f32 records

discovery.roots: Independent random 12-hidden-TANH networks; first three become receiving parents, fourth is donor
discovery.search: Six generations per root, eight residual stumps per generation; retain best native-scorer improvement only; archive every attempt and accepted creature
discovery.proposals: Random feature and observed discovery threshold; branch mean residual times random scale from [-1, 0.25, 0.5, 1, 2, 4]
discovery.candidateStream: 24 further donor proposals, all retained regardless of source success, followed by the same 24 payloads in the same order
discovery.ancestry: No cross-lineage inheritance; complete canonical root-to-parent hashes backed by retained creature snapshots and native search measurements

calibration.selection: Smallest sample with zero false screen rejections of calibration target wins over all three runs and four seeds; within sample choose smallest margin; if none qualifies report inconclusive and do not run validation

validation.repetitions: Eight fixed-input sample pairs within each of three independent discovery runs; no adaptive proposals or validation-based reselection
validation.scorer: Pinned native scorer, CPU MSE, cleared environment and one thread, same binary in both arms
validation.parents: Immutable; single-enhancement replay, both unrelated peer checks even after first rejection, full target judge before acceptance

maintenance.retain: Every run complete and failure-free, no lost wins, lower paired rate interval above minimum gain in each run; assess limited independent-run uncertainty separately
maintenance.remove: Any complete real-data run exceeds lost-win allowance, or its paired rate interval lies wholly below zero; timing evidence alone remains indicative on the shared host
maintenance.inconclusive: Calibration fails, incomplete coverage, operational failure, or neither retain nor remove; never claim optimisation benefit
maintenance.actionOnRemove: Remove optional sample/peer/cache runtime policy; preserve experiment evidence and ordinary replay

accounting: Charge input inspection, data retrieval/preparation, builds, search, calibration, freeze, replay, sample materialisation, scoring, ledger writes and outer-command residual; split shared costs equally; never count eight sample seeds as eight independent discovery runs
privacy: Keep corpora, creature snapshots, raw source/search receipts and path-bearing manifests outside checkout; publish application-agnostic aggregate outcomes and cryptographic commitments only
